targets.arrival: First MLB season with positive PA for hitting prospects or positive IP for pitching prospects; prior MLB arrivals excluded from pre-debut forecasts.
targets.regular_role: First season >=400 PA for non-catcher hitters, >=300 PA for catchers, or >=80 IP for starters / >=40 IP for relievers. Playing-time milestone, not guaranteed fantasy relevance.
targets.workload: MLB PA/IP per calendar season after arrival, including verified zero seasons; right-censored years omitted, not zeros.

selection.training_end: Strictly previous calendar year; outcomes used for selection only through 2018.
selection.selection_metric: Arrival cumulative Brier and conditional workload MAE, selected independently.

evaluation.training_end: 2018 and 2019 respectively; parameters selected only from pre-2019 outcomes.
evaluation.status: Previously inspected historical cohorts reused. New-model chronological evaluation, not an untouched holdout.
evaluation.covid: 2020 retained for actual arrival dates; volume year 2020 omitted from ordinary-year workload scoring and conditional workload donors. First-regular milestone never attained using an annualized 2020 proxy.

benchmarks.arrival: Role-specific empirical discrete-time hazard by lag, without player covariates.
benchmarks.first_year_workload: Half of role reference workload (509 PA, 171 SP IP, 56.6667 RP IP) conditional on arrival.
benchmarks.regular_role: Immediate regular role or fixed one-calendar-year delay, conditional on arrival.

features: Snapshot rank, age, role, level, and dated published FanGraphs ETA when present. Missingness explicit. No realized outcome labels, future MLB performance, future scouting or current 2026 information in historical features.
censoring: No MLB arrival by the source end is right-censored, not permanent bust. Observed zero MLB years require complete annual export coverage and stable identity. Duplicate snapshots weighted by inverse count per player.
current_scope: Prospect-only arrival and conditional playing-time diagnostics. Neutral DD values and MLB forecasts preserved. Do not multiply timing probabilities into existing unconditional prospect paths; that would double-count non-arrival/bust risk.
release: Publish a diagnostic candidate with calibration limits. Central competitive fit remains withheld until joint talent, workload and arrival outcome paths are coherently validated. No forced half-season workload or one-year delay. Out-of-domain ranks/levels and sparse role groups explicitly flagged.
